svg.title: Your brand. One Kardy wallet.
svg.desc: Illustrative Sunday Coffee and Good Company cards, together in the Kardy browser wallet. Sunday Coffee has four of ten stamps; Good Company has two of eight. Each business keeps separate rewards and progress. Apple Wallet and Google Wallet native passes are supported when issuance is enabled. Not a live account or an installed native wallet pass.

g.text: A little something, just for you.
Separate rewards. Separate progress. Kept together.
